# F3 — synthetic-verified

This directory intentionally contains no Unity asset bytes. It validates only that the CLI handles an empty, explicitly labeled directory deterministically when asked for verified-only diagnostics, texture export, and fallback-catalog input. It is **not** an emulator or a compatibility fixture for Unity 2021.3 or 2022.3.

Real modern Unity acceptance requires a user-authorized plaintext build or bundle set with a reported engine version and readable schema coverage.
